魏阿巧: A’qiao / the Wei girl, seventeen-year-old daughter of Mr Wei; distinct from adult A’qiao
阿祥: A’xiang, seventeen-year-old servant bought into Hu’s household; already bears master’s surname
魏老板: Mr Wei, owner of small grocery
无锡大阿福: cheerful Wuxi clay doll; distinct from chairbearer A’fu
王宝和: Wang Baohe tavern; proprietor Mr Wang
盐桥/纯号: Salt Bridge / Chunhao tavern in Hangzhou
独脚蟹: one-legged crabs, nickname for sprouted beans
嵇鹤龄: Ji Heling, Hu’s older sworn brother
春梅浆: spring-plum pulp, local term for an unhappy match that leaves the matchmaker endlessly mediating disputes
小张/孙祥太: Little Zhang of Hangzhou / Sun Xiangtai of Jiaxing
贷款两笔: proposed 1,000 silver dollars to A’xiang; separate proposed 10,000 taels to Fatty Zhang for Fukang shares plus management salary
